traits.life_span.note: DELTA Linderniaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly annual herbs, a few shrubs or subshrubs.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Linderniaceae: leaves opposite; leaves usually simple, sometimes compound; margins entire, crenate or serrate; veins pinnate or palmate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; flowers turned over usually absent, sometimes present; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems usually herbaceous, sometimes woody; flowers solitary, in racemes or in heads; flowers zygomorphic; irregular flowers bilabiate; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; stamens 2 to 4; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Linderniaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
